source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: paratransit OR "informal transport" OR "auto-rickshaw" OR "minibus taxi" OR matatu
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:paratransit OR "informal transport" OR "auto-rickshaw" OR "minibus taxi" OR matatu,is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("informal transport" OR "minibus taxi" OR "auto-rickshaw" OR "matatu" OR "paratransit")
